title: A Banach algebra encoding quantum group duality
summary: We introduce and study a new Banach algebra structure on the trace-zero subspace $\mathcal{T}(L^2(\mathbb{G}))_0$ of trace class operators for any locally compact quantum group $\mathbb{G}$; it is defined through a mixed Lie-type product of the two dual products on $\mathcal{T}(L^2(\mathbb{G}))$ arising from the canonical extensions of the co-products of $\mathbb{G}$ and $\widehat{\mathbb{G}}$. The surprising fact that this new product is indeed associative stems precisely from the duality of the latter two products.
